player_prompt.intro:
Kɩlaŋ kɛna Hanoi tɛɛ tɔm tɛɛ {num_disks} tɔm.
Ɛɛʊ kɛna tɔm ɖɩsɩ A tɔm taa C tɔm taa.
Tɔm ɖɩsɩ kɩlaŋ, tɔm tɛɛ kɩlaŋ pɩsɩ pɩsɩ tɔm tɛɛ (kpɛlɛkɛ [A C] tɛɛ).
Kɩlaŋ mbʊ ɛyaa tɔm tɛɛ tɔm taa, nɛ tɔm sɔsɔɛ tɛɛ ɛtaa tɔm cikpelɛɛ tɛɛ.
Kɩlaŋ kʊyɔɔ, tɔm kʊyɔɔ kʊyɔɔ.

board.current_board: Ɛjaɖɛ nɖɩ ɖɩ-taa palɩza ŋgbɛyɛ ńɖɩ yɔ: {board}.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Ŋwɩlɩ-ɖʋ ɖenɖe pɩlɩnaa yɔ yaa lone nɖɩ ɖɩ-taa pɩwɛɛ se ŋwolo yɔ.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Ŋñaɣ pana nɛ ŋlɩzɩ tɔm ndʋ tɩ-taa natʋyʋ.
invalid_move.same_tower: Ŋñaɣ pana se ŋyele nɛ tɔm ndʋ tɩkɔɔ pɩ-taa.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Ŋñaɣ pana nɛ ŋsɩɩ wondu ndʋ tɩkɩlɩ-ŋ tɔlʋʋ yɔ, lɛɛtʋ yɔɔ.

game_action.moved: Mɛ nɩŋga kɩgbɛŋga {disk} kɔɔ ŋɖɛ lɛ, ŋɩɣtʊ ŋɛyɔ {source} hɛkʊ taa {target}.

outcome.win: Ɩlabɩ ɖeu, ɩcɔnɩ Hanoi kuduyuu sɔsɔʋ tɔm.
